assert t.render(use_i18n=True, count=5) == "5 apples"
assert t.render(use_i18n=False, count=5) == "no"
print("newstyle plural OK")

# parity check: ctrans renders identically to trans for the same content
def parity(env, gettext_fn, ngettext_fn, newstyle):
    e1 = Environment(autoescape=True, extensions=["jinja2.ext.i18n"])
    e2 = Environment(autoescape=True, extensions=["jinja2.ext.i18n", "jinja2.ext.conditional_i18n"])
    for e in (e1, e2):
        e.install_gettext_callables(gettext_fn, ngettext_fn, newstyle=newstyle)
    src_trans = '{% trans %}Hello {{ name }}{% endtrans %}'
    src_ctrans_true = '{% ctrans true %}Hello {{ name }}{% fallback %}plain{% endctrans %}'
    src_ctrans_false = '{% ctrans false %}Hello {{ name }}{% fallback %}plain {{ name }}{% endctrans %}'
    assert e1.from_string(src_trans).render(name="<b>") == e2.from_string(src_ctrans_true).render(name="<b>")
    print(f"parity newstyle={newstyle} OK")

parity(None, lambda x: "<strong>" + x, lambda s, p, n: s, newstyle=False)
parity(None, lambda x: "<strong>" + x, lambda s, p, n: s, newstyle=True)
parity(None, lambda x: x, lambda s, p, n: s, newstyle=False)

t = env7.from_string("{% ctrans a %}T1{% fallback %}F1{% endctrans %}mid{% ctrans b %}T2{% fallback %}F2{% endctrans %}")
assert t.render(a=True, b=False) == "T1midF2"
assert t.render(a=False, b=True) == "F1midT2"
print("multiple ctrans OK")

# ctrans inside for loop (scoped vars)
t = env7.from_string("{% for i in items %}{% ctrans use %}[{{ i }}]{% fallback %}({{ i }}){% endctrans %}{% endfor %}")
assert t.render(items=[1, 2], use=True) == "[1][2]"
assert t.render(items=[1, 2], use=False) == "(1)(2)"

env9.globals["gettext"] = lambda x: "T:" + x
env9.globals["ngettext"] = lambda s, p, n: "N:" + (s if n == 1 else p)
t = env9.from_string("{% trans %}a{% endtrans %}{% ctrans c %}b{% fallback %}c{% endctrans %}")
assert t.render(c=True) == "T:aT:b"
assert t.render(c=False) == "T:ac"

t = env7.from_string("{% ctrans use count=get() %}{{ count }}{% fallback %}f{% endctrans %}")
assert t.render(use=True, get=lambda: 3) == "3"
assert t.render(use=False, get=lambda: 3) == "f"

env10.globals["ngettext"] = lambda s, p, n: s

assert t.render(use=False) == "  f\n  world  ", repr(t.render(use=False))

{% endctrans %}""")

assert t.render(use=False, x=1) == "\nFB one 1\nFB two\n", repr(t.render(use=False, x=1))

import asyncio
from jinja2 import Environment as AsyncEnv
aenv = AsyncEnv(extensions=["jinja2.ext.conditional_i18n"], enable_async=True)
aenv.globals["gettext"] = lambda x: x
aenv.globals["ngettext"] = lambda s, p, n: s
t = aenv.from_string("{% ctrans use %}A{% fallback %}B{% endctrans %}")
out = asyncio.get_event_loop().run_until_complete(t.render_async(use=True))
assert out == "A", out
out = asyncio.get_event_loop().run_until_complete(t.render_async(use=False))
assert out == "B", out
print("async OK")

# overlay / rebinding
original = Environment(extensions=[ConditionalI18nExtension])
original.globals["gettext"] = lambda x: x
overlay = original.overlay()
for e in (original, overlay):
    for ext in e.extensions.values():

env11 = Environment(extensions=["jinja2.ext.conditional_i18n"])
env11.globals["gettext"] = lambda x: x
env11.tests["even"] = lambda v: v % 2 == 0
t = env11.from_string("{% ctrans n is even %}E{% fallback %}O{% endctrans %}")
assert t.render(n=2) == "E"
assert t.render(n=3) == "O"
print("tests in condition OK")
